# convoy_endpoint (Resource)

An endpoint is a URL Convoy delivers webhook events to. In outgoing projects an endpoint usually represents one of your customers' webhook receivers; in incoming projects it is your own service.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "convoy_endpoint" "acme" {
  name          = "acme-production"
  url           = "https://hooks.acme.example.com/convoy"
  owner_id      = "customer_acme"
  description   = "Acme Corp production receiver"
  support_email = "oncall@acme.example.com"
  http_timeout  = 15

  # Changing secret later rotates it through Convoy's expire-secret API.
  secret            = var.acme_webhook_secret
  secret_expiration = 3600

  authentication = {
    type = "api_key"
    api_key = {
      header_name  = "X-Acme-Token"
      header_value = var.acme_token
    }
  }
}

variable "acme_webhook_secret" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "acme_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Endpoint name.
- `url` (String) URL events are delivered to.

### Optional

- `advanced_signatures` (Boolean) Use Convoy's advanced (timestamped, multi-version) signature format. Outgoing projects only.
- `authentication` (Attributes) Authentication Convoy performs against the endpoint. Set `type` and the matching nested object. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--authentication))
- `content_type` (String) `Content-Type` of delivered requests. Defaults to `application/json`.
- `description` (String) Human readable description.
- `http_timeout` (Number) Delivery HTTP timeout, in seconds.
- `mtls_client_cert` (Attributes) Client certificate used for mutual TLS with the endpoint. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--mtls_client_cert))
- `owner_id` (String) Groups several endpoints together so a single event can be [fanned out](https://www.getconvoy.io/docs/product-manual/endpoints) to all of them. Convoy does not allow clearing an owner ID once set.
- `paused` (Boolean) Whether deliveries to the endpoint are paused. Toggled through Convoy's pause API.
- `project_id` (String) ID of the project the object belongs to. Defaults to the provider's `project_id`. Changing this forces a new object to be created.
- `rate_limit` (Number) Maximum number of deliveries per `rate_limit_duration`.
- `rate_limit_duration` (Number) Rate limit window, in seconds.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Signing secret. Generated by Convoy when omitted. Changing it rotates the secret through Convoy's expire-secret API (the previous secret stays valid for `secret_expiration`) instead of recreating the endpoint.
- `secret_expiration` (Number) Grace period passed to Convoy's expire-secret API when `secret` changes, during which the previous secret remains valid. Defaults to `0`.
- `slack_webhook_url` (String) Slack incoming-webhook URL notified about endpoint failures.
- `support_email` (String) Email notified about endpoint state changes (e.g. disabled after failures). Requires a Convoy edition with advanced endpoint management.
- `teams_webhook_url` (String) Microsoft Teams (Workflows) webhook URL notified about endpoint failures.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier (`uid`) of the endpoint.
- `status` (String) Endpoint status: `active`, `inactive` (disabled after failures) or `paused`.

<a id="nestedatt--authentication"></a>
### Nested Schema for `authentication`

Required:

- `type` (String) Authentication type: `api_key`, `basic_auth` or `oauth2`.

Optional:

- `api_key` (Attributes) Static API key sent in a request header. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--authentication--api_key))
- `basic_auth` (Attributes) HTTP basic authentication credentials. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--authentication--basic_auth))
- `oauth2` (Attributes) OAuth2 client-credentials token exchange performed by Convoy before each delivery. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--authentication--oauth2))

<a id="nestedatt--authentication--api_key"></a>
### Nested Schema for `authentication.api_key`

Required:

- `header_name` (String) Header name, e.g. `Authorization`.
- `header_value` (String, Sensitive) Header value.


<a id="nestedatt--authentication--basic_auth"></a>
### Nested Schema for `authentication.basic_auth`

Required:

- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password.
- `username` (String) Username.


<a id="nestedatt--authentication--oauth2"></a>
### Nested Schema for `authentication.oauth2`

Required:

- `authentication_type` (String) How the client authenticates: `shared_secret` (requires `client_secret`) or `client_assertion` (requires `signing_key`).
- `client_id` (String) OAuth2 client ID.
- `url` (String) Token endpoint URL.

Optional:

- `audience` (String) Requested audience.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) Client secret, for `shared_secret`.
- `expiry_time_unit` (String) Unit of the token response expiry: `seconds`, `milliseconds`, `minutes` or `hours`.
- `field_mapping` (Attributes) Custom field names used to parse the token response. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--authentication--oauth2--field_mapping))
- `grant_type` (String) Grant type, defaults to `client_credentials`.
- `issuer` (String) JWT issuer, for `client_assertion`.
- `scope` (String) Requested scope.
- `signing_algorithm` (String) JWT signing algorithm, e.g. `ES256` or `RS256`.
- `signing_key` (String, Sensitive) JWK (as JSON, use `jsonencode()`) used to sign client assertions.
- `subject` (String) JWT subject, for `client_assertion`.

<a id="nestedatt--authentication--oauth2--field_mapping"></a>
### Nested Schema for `authentication.oauth2.field_mapping`

Optional:

- `access_token` (String) Field holding the access token, e.g. `accessToken`.
- `expires_in` (String) Field holding the expiry.
- `token_type` (String) Field holding the token type.




<a id="nestedatt--mtls_client_cert"></a>
### Nested Schema for `mtls_client_cert`

Required:

- `client_cert` (String) PEM encoded client certificate.
- `client_key` (String, Sensitive) PEM encoded private key.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <project_id>/<endpoint_id>, or just <endpoint_id> when the provider sets project_id.
terraform import convoy_endpoint.acme 01H0JA5MEES38RRK3HTEJC647K/01H0JATTVCXZK8FRDX1M1JN3QY
```
